observed_defect: Broad flat lawn dominates camera view; no valley or ridge contour visible, lacking natural topography for strategy gameplay.
design_intent: Introduce a single, broad, shallow valley with negative Z displacement to establish visual hierarchy and terrain flow, avoiding straight lines or isolated mounds.
reason_for_new_geometry: Valley creates focal depth and traversable terrain without disrupting city pad or sector boundaries; aligns with camera perspective and avoids prior model's flatness.

planned_actions.rationale: Define valley with three non-collinear knots for curvature and depth.

expected_visual_difference: Camera now reveals a broad, shallow valley with natural slope, enhancing strategy legibility and terrain variety without altering city or sector boundaries.
mobile_risks: Minimal; valley depth is shallow and uniform, avoiding complex mesh deformation or high-poly regions.
